subject: python
decision: reused from ADR-0187 decision 193 for spikee; owner to confirm (ADR-0245)
why: the CPython runtime of the base image (the same pinned python:3.12-slim-trixie as garak's); PSF-2.0, permissive, not on the ADR-0176 list. Accepted for garak on 2026-10-10 (ADR-0187 decision 193).

subject: aiohappyeyeballs
decision: reused from ADR-0187 decision 193 for spikee; owner to confirm (ADR-0245)
why: a dependency of aiohttp in spikee's closure (the same 2.7.1 as garak's); PSF-2.0, permissive, not on the list. Accepted for garak (ADR-0187 decision 193).

subject: typing_extensions
decision: reused from ADR-0187 decision 193 for spikee; owner to confirm (ADR-0245)
why: a typing backport used throughout the closure (pydantic, openai, anthropic); PSF-2.0, permissive, not on the list. Accepted for garak (ADR-0187 decision 193).

subject: certifi
decision: reused from ADR-0187 decision 193 for spikee; owner to confirm (ADR-0245)
why: the CA bundle (requests, httpx); MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft with obligations only if its files are modified. Admitted only while unmodified: the gate checks every file against its wheel RECORD hash (ADR-0187 decision 194). Accepted for garak (decision 193).

subject: tqdm
decision: reused from ADR-0187 decision 193 for spikee; owner to confirm (ADR-0245)
why: spikee's progress bars (a direct dependency, pinned by spikee at 4.67.3); MPL-2.0 AND MIT per its LICENCE file, unmodified. Admitted only while unmodified (decision 194). Accepted for garak (decision 193).

subject: regex
decision: reused from ADR-0187 decision 193 for spikee; owner to confirm (ADR-0245)
why: tiktoken's regular-expression engine; Apache-2.0 AND CNRI-Python (the parts derived from CPython's re), permissive. Accepted for garak (decision 193).

subject: numpy
decision: reused from ADR-0187 decision 106 for spikee; owner to confirm (ADR-0245)
why: pandas' and pyarrow's array library; Zlib is a permissive licence on code numpy ships. Accepted for modelscan and reused for garak (ADR-0187 decision 106).

subject: numpy.libs/libgfortran
decision: reused from ADR-0187 decision 106 for spikee; owner to confirm (ADR-0245)
why: the GCC runtime library under the GCC Runtime Library Exception, shipped unmodified inside numpy's wheel (ADR-0187 decision 106).

subject: numpy.libs/libquadmath
decision: reused from ADR-0187 decision 106 for spikee; owner to confirm (ADR-0245)
why: an unmodified, dynamically linked LGPL library shipped as its own shared object inside numpy's wheel (ADR-0187 decision 106).
